scientific_integrity: A self-contained mathematical deduction from the cited theorem, with a replayable standard-library checker. Finite checks do not replace the infinite proof. No external or independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Theorems concern congruence images of indices with Motzkin values divisible by five, not values or exact ordinary integer sums. The 2004 Deutsch--Sagan index characterization is an external premise. Exact representation multiplicities and zeros modulo higher prime powers are outside scope. Potential historical implicit coverage by general automatic-set sumset theory remains a priority risk.
title: The exact five-adic two-sum image and sharp four-summand coverage of Motzkin-zero indices
